name: cloud-sync-auth-v342
validatedCases: configured client uses PKCE and SDK session persistence
service-role style browser credential is rejected
initial signed-out session exposes no user or token
initialization registers exactly one auth state listener
SIGNED_IN updates synchronous engine identity cache
public snapshot never exposes access or refresh token
auth state refresh replaces cached authenticated identity
transport token callback reads current SDK session instead of a FE QUEST token store
magic-link sign-in normalizes email and uses configured redirect
device sign-out uses local scope and clears only cached auth identity
failed provider sign-out does not falsely clear local authenticated state
dispose unsubscribes auth listener without touching learner data
auth provider failure is nonfatal and independent from learner data
